reviews.t: Fantastic product! Goes on smooth and has just the right shimmer--NO PANDA EYES! Amazing!
reviews.x: So I rarely write reviews, however after receiving this product and using it, I thought I should spread the word so others could enjoy! If you have ever experienced hard nasty pencils that poke your eye out, or color that bleeds everywhere and by the end of the day you look like a panda in the office, then you should DEFINITELY get this pencil! It went on so smooth and made my eyes look very defined. The most amazing part is that by day end, I had not reapplied and it was still there looking shi

reviews.t: Sooo smooth!
reviews.x: This eyeliner pencil goes on so smoothly. The color RAVEN is beautiful, not too dark. It seems to have a touch of gray in it, giving it a soft look.  My friends noticed that my eyes really "popped" the first time I wore it with the It's So BIG Mascara and I received many compliments. Thank you Elizabeth Mott for another great product!

reviews.t: Awesome liner for dancers who work around lighting
reviews.x: Awesome liner for dancers who work around lighting. Not 100% smudge free. I find that they start to smudge after 4 hours at best. Also, it would be nice if it came in black but the raven color is pretty similar to black. So far I have yet to find an actual liner that doesn't smudge so this is my favorite one, for now.

reviews.t: poor product
reviews.x: Not what I expected.  Eyeliner goes on very poorly.  Smears easily.  Cannot twist up the liner.  Would not order again and would not recommend.  Very disappointed.

reviews.t: fabulous liner, hate sharpening it
reviews.x: I absolutely love this eyeliner. It glides on and stays all day. So why 3 stars? Sharpening it is a real chore. I really wish it was a twist up. When I need to sharpen it, I put it in the freezer for at least 1/2 hour or longer. Then I use the best sharpener I can find. Then  I refrigerate it so I can smooth the tip a bit before using it again otherwise it tends to crumble on the tip after sharpening. So even though this is the best liner I've ever had, unfortunately I am still looking, and will

reviews.t: Looks different than in the picture.
reviews.x: I thought I was getting a dark gray color and a fat stubby smooth gel pencil.  I was surprised to get a thin dark black eye pencil shadow liner. I have had to sharpen the pencil 3 times already in 2 days. At this rate, it will not last. I found it uneven in its application. As a result, I had to use another eye liner pencil I had to go over it so it would not look so bad. I would not order this one again. It did not work for me.

reviews.t: great liner!
reviews.x: greattt liner! Love the quality, but I don't think I cared for mine properly because I would bring it with me and it would melt and change the consistency of the liner. Would def recommend and would def give it another try. The brand.. has great mascara too! Looking forward to giving it another try and other products by this brand as well.

reviews.t: Love It!
reviews.x: I would have given this a 5 star except for sharpening it.  I find it hard to sharpen which is frustrating.  I am trying a different sharpener that is made for softer crayon like liners, hoping that this will work.  Otherwise, I love it.  Once it's on it stays on all day and doesn't run.  It also is very easy to apply.  Love it!!

reviews.t: A GREAT product!! I recommend it :)
reviews.x: I really like this product a LOT!! It remains on my waterline better than other similar products that I have tried...but it still slides off alas.THAT said, I DO like it better than the other ones I have tried and it is very gently on the eyes and looks really good!!

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: The best eyeliner ever. Does not smear or smudge. Stays in place. I have tried them all and none can compare to this. A little pricey but well worth it. No smearing or smudging all day and even outside sweating and mowing still in place. The best eyeliner ever.

reviews.t: I really do love this. My only wish is it would come ...
reviews.x: I really do love this.  My only wish is it would come in a dark brown color.  It stays on beautifully and does not smudge.  The only way I'm able to remove it is with make-up remover.  Easy to sharpen if you have a good sharpener and is so easy to use.

reviews.t: I love this eye liner
reviews.x: I love this eye liner. It doesn't run and is so soft it glides right on. It does require a pencil sharpener so be sure to have one on hand to keep a nice point. Best part for me is it is cruelty free. I will be buying this again!

reviews.t: Great eyeliner pencil
reviews.x: Great eyeliner pencil! It goes on very smooth and easily, and I love the touch of sparkle. I have the Raven so far but will probably purchase the other colors. My only complaint is that I almost have to sharpen it with every application, or it tends to go on too thick for daytime wear. It never smudges but still removes easily with coconut oil and my regular cleanser. This is definitely my go-to from now on; I'm hoping they come out with some other colors, too!

reviews.t: The most amazing eyeliner pencil ever
reviews.x: This is one of the best eyeliner pencils I have ever used. I have fairly oily skin, so even with an eyeshadow primer, my eyeliner would run or smudge off by the end of the day. I don't have that with this. This bad boy stays put all day. ALL. DAY. I can smudge it out to get the great cat-eye look that I love, or I can just apply it as normal. It's very smooth, goes on fairly easy and no tugging on my eyelids. I just...I'm speechless; ts amazing.

reviews.t: I do like that it has less chemicals in it
reviews.x: Definitely not a smooth application, but using a primer on my lids before hand really helps. I do like that it has less chemicals in it, so I suppose it's a fair trade (smooth application for healthier product). I was going to return it, but decided to keep it and see if I like it in the long run. Since I use a primer it's hard to tell so far how long the wear is, but it lasts just as long as the Buxom I usually use.

reviews.t: what a great product! Glide on is exactly what this liner ...
reviews.x: what a great product! Glide on is exactly what this liner does! No pulling on the eyelid at all and it's so light you forget you have it on and believe me I've tried many eye liners and this one is a keeper! I would definitely recommend this liner!

reviews.t: I do however love the mascara and I should have ordered the dark ...
reviews.x: the sparkles in the shadow get everywhere and the color was not what i thought it would be.I do however love the mascara and I should have ordered the dark eye shadow or the light one. My name is Jackie Chavez not Mike Chavez.

reviews.t: Holy grail eyeliner! So happy I found it!
reviews.x: LOVE this eyeliner! It goes on so smooth and doesn't smudge (unless you want it to!) by the end of the day. It's the perfect smoky black and I absolutely love that it's cruelty free. Found my holy grail eyeliner! (Finally!)

reviews.t: Best I've used
reviews.x: It goes on very dark and smooth. You can also create a smokey eye effect. It doesn't smear, even after dancing all night. I've tried several eyeliners, expensive and cheap, but this is the best I've used.

reviews.t: Very happy with this eyeliner so far
reviews.x: Very happy with this eyeliner so far! I usually use Urban Decay 24/7 but bought this on a whim to try. Goes on smoothly, stays on well. The color (Raven) is nice with the ever-so-faintest sparkle.

reviews.t: The color is nice but the pencil is just too soft and creamy ...
reviews.x: The color is nice but the pencil is just too soft and creamy for me. It also doesn't blend very well. Not happy with the purchase.

reviews.t: Good product
reviews.x: Good product. Stays on well. Only problem I had was when I sharpened it, about a quarter of the stick was empty.

reviews.t: Three Stars
reviews.x: easy to put on, but the twist-up- pencil mechanism does not work well

reviews.t: FANTASTIC EYE PENCIL!!!!
reviews.x: As the name suggests, Elizabeth Mott's Smooth Shadow Eye Pencil glides on REALLY smoothly! Am still figuring out how they managed to get so much color and moisture into a smudge-free, waterproof formula - GENIUS! I think it's important to note that the formula comes off easily at the end of the day without excessive rubbing. It's the perfect eye pencil - THANK YOU EM!!!

reviews.t: I really loved this Elizabeth Mott eye liner pencil when I first ...
reviews.x: I really loved this Elizabeth Mott eye liner pencil when I first started using it. Unfortunately, after I sharpened it, the pencil inside was mushy and gooey and there was no way it would sharpen. I had mushy goo stuck all over my eye pencil sharpener and still not able to sharpen and use my new Elizabeth Mott eye pencil! Had to return it!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the liner glides on smoothly and stays put all day without smudging or running.
Several reviewers complain that the pencil is hard to sharpen and requires frequent sharpening, and some wish it were a twist-up.
Some reviewers report that it smudges or smears after a few hours, contrary to the long-wear claims.
A few reviewers mention the Raven color is a nice soft dark shade, though some wish it came in black or dark brown.
Some reviewers note uneven or poor application, with one finding it different from the picture.
